# Agent-Safe Takeaways

- Preserve donor identity when inference is about biological replicates rather than individual cells.
- Report cell and gene QC before clustering, annotation, or differential testing.
- Use truth-aware benchmarks for simulated cell types, perturbations, and eQTL effects.

# Inputs to Specify

- Gene and cell counts
- Cell-type or group configuration
- Expression and technical-noise parameters

# Expected Outputs

- Gene-by-cell count matrix
- Cell metadata
- Simulation parameters

# Limitations and Guardrails

- Reference-free simulators can miss dataset-specific correlation and protocol effects.
- Use independent QC to evaluate sparsity, depth, and cell-type separation.

# Questions This Record Can Ground
